name: Adeshwar Meditex Limited
summary: Adeshwar Meditex Ltd. is an Indian company, headquartered in Mumbai, that specializes in the production of medical supplies. Established in 1951 by Mulchand Talati, the firm manufactures a variety of surgical dressings and topical preparations. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes sterile surgical wound dressings, tulle dressings, an assortment of medical disposables, adhesive bandages, absorbent gauze, plasters, disinfectants, and full medical kits.
